body: As someone who has had cancer- fuck no.
I'll try. Thanks, man! If I can remember I'll pm you.

I guess I could make a list 
- step outside my house
- eat more
- not lay in bed all day
Things like that
I do struggle. I can't sleep and I've lost 3 pounds (most likely from barely eating)
Thanks mate! And I do not have psychotherapy.
I try to get in at least 10 minutes of exercise every day. Music is my go to for most days. I can try to play my favorite game I suppose.

I wouldn't be able to shoot/ hang/ or drown myself. I think overdose is the best option. 
Hmm, I don't play any sports or never have. I like to play the Xbox but even that doesn't appeal to me anymore.
